column1:
It's funny how 
your plans never...

But they always are 
in retrospect

fallen from grey skiеs 
like pesticides

Note on the dresser. 
one line, it read:

She's always been one 
for satire

Bright in the lamp 
fire's light,

Burning ships 
in black seas, 
we capsize

The pulse of the city 
flatlines

Four eyes, 
two points of focus

We play our lines 
like a writer's opus

One side to the dice 
we're rolling

Snake eyes 
and the fire's molten

Way signs to be tired 
by her tears

I take her word 
like snake oil

Grease for the bearings, 
get thy

Sleepy and staring 
into space time

Close enough 
to push away 
closing up

Burning ships 
in black seas, 
we capsize

The pulse of the city 
flatlines
